description: This file is a shell script containing tests for Git's sparse-checkout and removal functionalities, including setup, expected behaviors, and validation of sparse-checkout behavior with 'git rm'.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executes the provided commands, and checks assertions.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the command it runs fails with a non-zero exit status.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or inputs for equality.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the provided input or output is empty.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a specific file or path is missing from the file system.
